title: 转录流
summary: 实时多说话人转录流不应粗暴全量重绘；在会前声纹抽屉预先建档，在会中以打字机平滑追加字词、解决后验换名与重叠抢话碰撞，并在会后无缝跃迁至双栏时间轴与结构化纪要。
summaryEn: A real-time multi-speaker transcript stream avoids jarring full redraws; it registers voiceprints pre-meeting, smoothly appends tokens with typewriter pacing while resolving late speaker identification and cross-talk collisions live, and transitions to split-screen minutes post-meeting.
asks: 实时多说话人转录流如何平滑处理增量打字、声纹后验认人与重叠抢话？
asksEn: How does a real-time multi-speaker transcript stream smoothly handle incremental typing, late-bound speaker identification, and cross-talk collisions?

links.when: 转录流是真实人际多轮对话与声纹时空绑定，不是单体 AI 助手交互形态
links.whenEn: a transcript stream is multi-speaker interpersonal speech bound in spacetime, not an AI assistant persona

links.when: 流式语音是持续时间轴上的 token/turn 增量打字机，不是记录集翻页或末尾批量追加
links.whenEn: streaming speech is incremental typewriter flow along a continuous timeline, not batch paging or collection appending

links.when: 重叠抢话是就地气泡视觉呼吸与状态胶囊，不是模态或打断式通知
links.whenEn: cross-talk collision is an in-situ breathing bubble border and status capsule, not an interrupting notification

links.when: 会后双栏分屏是时间轴流水与纪要画布的语义联动，不是通用等宽栅格
links.whenEn: the post-meeting dual pane is a semantic link between timeline transcript and formal minutes, not a generic grid
